newsitem.title: GERMANY: Airlines battle for stagnating German pax market.
newsitem.headline: Airlines battle for stagnating German pax market.

text.p: The German air travel market is stagnating as European airlines battle for shares of the continent's largest passenger market, the German airport association ADV said.
Passenger traffic in February showed zero growth with 7.4 million trips in the run-up to European air liberalisation from April 1, the latest ADV monthly traffic report showed.
This followed 3.5 percent growth in January which was boosted by New Year and winter holiday travel.
In 1996, the German passenger travel market grew 2.6 percent to more than 113 million trips.
The domestic market, currently the scene of a price war between Deutsche Lufthansa AG, Deutsche BA and Eurowings Luftverkehrs AG, declined 2.4 percent in February, the ADV said.

Total passenger numbers to European destinations, marked by strong competition between Lufthansa and national carriers such as Air France, KLM Royal Dutch Airlines and Swissair, also fell slightly, the ADV report showed.
